Summary: high priority gov/defense maritime lab. Want fully air-gapped Private deployment inside naval test range network. Primary workload = real-time chat for watch-standers + mass ingestion/search of annotated sensor logs (sonar, AIS, radar) + automated briefing generation for commanders.

Constraints / must-haves:
- No egress: images must be delivered as signed offline artifacts (we will need an airgap installer + image tar).
- KMS: in-country HSM / customer-managed keys mandatory (cannot use Redwood-managed keys).
- Compliance: CMMC L3, ITAR controls on model weights, audit logs retained 7+ years, strict data residency.
- Certification: procurement asking for IL4/IL5 attestation language in SOW; security team flagged need for annual penetration test report.

Technical notes from 11/18 call w/ CTO (Lt. Cmdr. R. Hale):
- "We cannot stream telemetry offsite; any KV cache must be local and purged on schedule."
- Current GPU estate: 4x A40 nodes in isolated rack; will need guidance on quantized model variant to meet 50ms p50 for short chat flows. Throughput target = 200 concurrent watch-stander sessions, burst to 800 for drills.
- Model preferences: open-vocabulary LLM ok but weights must be transport-controlled (no external model downloads). They asked about Redwood Optimize to reduce token cost on high-volume telemetry summarization.

POC ask / success criteria:
- Deliverable: air-gapped installer image + verification checklist; run inference locally against provided sensor corpus (10M tokens) and produce briefing summaries with ROUGE/BLEU baseline; measure p50 latency <120ms on local hardware for short prompts.
- Security: provide step-by-step SBOM and signed image manifest; provide KMS/HSM integration guide and sample policy.

Risks / open items:
- Procurement delay if legal cannot accept model-export restrictions (ITAR) as written.
- Network engineering requires explicit checklist for offline registry import process.
- Need to confirm pricing for airgap packaging + on-site support (request from finance).
